title: The Lions of Africa
text:
Lions are wild animals. They live in Africa. Lions live in big groups called prides. A pride can have many lions, and they stay together.

Lions sleep for many hours every day. At night, they hunt for food. The female lions hunt most of the time. The male lions protect the pride.

questions.text: What do lions do at night?
Why do you think lions live together in a pride?
options: They help each other and stay safe
They do not like other animals

questions.text: Why do you think lions need to sleep so much?
options: They use a lot of energy when they hunt
They do not like the sun

vocabulary.definition: not tamed or kept by people
groups of lions that live together
chase and kill animals for food
keep someone or something safe from harm

paragraph_translations: Leões são animais selvagens. Eles vivem na África. Os leões vivem em grupos grandes chamados bandos. Um bando pode ter muitos leões, e eles ficam juntos.
Os leões dormem muitas horas todos os dias. À noite, eles caçam comida. As leoas caçam a maior parte do tempo. Os leões machos protegem o bando.
